issues.description: The addRating(stars:) method is declared without an access modifier in the problem statement and the template (intended to be callable from client code), but in the solution it is declared as private. However, Client.swift in the solution calls swiftCourse.addRating(...). Declaring the method private restricts it to its source file and prevents Client.swift (a different file) from calling it, causing a visibility/compilation mismatch between the implementation and its intended usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the addRating(stars:) method accessible to client code by removing the private modifier (use the default internal visibility) or declare it as public if it should be accessible across modules. This aligns the implementation with the template and the intended usage in Client.swift.
